# This competition is in celebration of WCA Newcomer Month! This competition is catered to all speedcubing newcomers and we welcome you to register for this competition!
- Bay Area Speedcubin' is proud to partner with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) and [CubersLive](https://www.facebook.com/CubersLive) to bring another competition to Northern California with a **focus on the live-stream and first-time competitor experience!**
- This competition will be testing the new revolutionary score-taking technology, **TimeBase!** We will be using traditional scorecards but will be offering a brand-new, paperless scoretaking experience for all registered competitors!
- This competition will be running a **Stationary Solve Station** set-up!
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.

# Competitors can bring 1 guest for free to the competition! If they would like to bring a 2nd or more guests, we are charging $5 per extra guest via paypal at the front desk. Spectators not associated with the competition may still pay the $5 fee to attend and watch the competition up close and personal!

items.name: DFW Megacomp 2024
items.information:
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**New competitors registration will be accepted based on the following:**
* The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
* If greater than 25% of new competitors register, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If less than 25% of new competitors register before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:**

* The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
* If 25% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis.
* If 25% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

---

As the month of March is WCA Newcomer Month, 25% of the competitor limit will be reserved for first-time competitors or competitors who's first competition is in 2024. More information can be found on the [WCA Newcomer Month tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#36408-wca-newcomer-month).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGhZIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--392ac2f0728e8e69ef497494e33b38b6b56bc2f4/565a7d59-6eb6-4b27-af6a-ad3bd4963ec0.png)

# ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.***

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#35850-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

Day 1 Events: 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, Clock, Pyraminx

Day 2 Events: 3x3x3 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Megaminx, Square-1

This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

items.name: German Newcomer Day 2024
items.information:
**English**

**This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**Registrations will be accepted based on the following:**
* 60 spots (50% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors.
* 60 spots (50% of spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If more than 60 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the 60 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Deutsch**

**Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt.

**Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:**
* 60 Plätze (50% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert.
* 60 Plätze (50% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar.
* Wenn sich mehr als 60 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 60 Plätze von den zurückgekehrten Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen.
* Wenn die 60 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

items.name: Minnesota Newcomer Sunday 2024
items.information:
This is a very beginner-friendly competition!  All are welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for! 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaFJjIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--51111b9a3e31767ba773023b6b77e41414361d4a/image.png)

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:
* 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greather than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. 
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. 

**This competition is a series competition with [Minnesota Newcomer Saturday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaNewcomerSaturday2024).  You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.**

[Please click here for more information about series competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaNewcomerSunday2024#34017-series-competitions-faq)

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaE5jIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2bd2c962584c71cb83666f3f9263bbf13f251bb9/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

items.information:
Välkomna till First Friday First FMC Täby 2024!

Även om denna tävling skiljer sig mycket från en vanlig kubtävling i Sverige så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta. Det är dock extra viktigt att alla deltagare läser all information på denna sida, för att inte missa något gällande denna tävlings speciella upplägg och regler.

##### Grenen 3x3x3 körs inte i denna tävling. Den enda grenen som körs är "3x3x3 Minst Antal Drag"

-----

Welcome to First Friday First FMC Täby 2024!

Although this competition is very different from a regular speedcubing competition in Sweden, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate. However, it is especially important that all participants read all the information on this page, so as not to miss anything regarding the special structure and rules of this competition.

##### The event 3x3x3 will not take place in this competition. The only event taking place will be "3x3x3 Fewest Moves"
